saturn.text: Saturn is in the 8th sign from the Moon from 30 May 2032 to 12 July 2034.
Saturn is in the 12th, 1st or 2nd sign from the Moon (Erashtaka) from 2 June 2027 to 20 October 2027.
Saturn is in the 12th, 1st or 2nd sign from the Moon (Erashtaka) from 23 February 2028 to 12 July 2034.

overlaps.text: Both are in one of these Saturn periods from 30 May 2032 to 12 July 2034.
